# Kongono Framework v1.3 — Compact LLM Reference (llms.txt)

## Routing, AOT Compilation & Attributes (`Kongono\Http\Routing\*`)
- `#[Prefix('/api/v1')]`, `#[Get('/items')]`, `#[Post('/items')]`, `#[Put('/items/{id:\d+}')]`, `#[Patch('/items/{id:\d+}')]`, `#[Delete('/items/{id:\d+}')]`
- `#[Middleware(RateLimitMiddleware::class)]`, `#[Idempotent(ttlSeconds: 3600)]`, `#[Can('billing.write')]`, `#[CacheControl(maxAge: 300, public: true)]`
- Static routes dispatch in O(1); dynamic routes pre-compile regexes. `kongo optimize` emits `var/cache/routes.compiled.php` (zero-reflection `Router::loadCompiledTable()`).

## Typed Validation & Multi-Platform SDKs (`Kongono\Validation\*`, `kongo sdk:generate`)
- `#[Required]`, `#[Min(2)]`, `#[Max(120)]`, `#[Between(1, 100000)]`, `#[Email]`, `#[Url]`, `#[In(['a', 'b'])]`, `#[Regex('/.../')]`
- Place attributes directly on `final readonly class` constructor parameters. Invalid input automatically returns HTTP 422 JSON.
- Generate typed Web/Mobile clients directly from routes & DTOs: `kongo sdk:generate --lang=ts|swift|kotlin|dart [--name=ApiClient] [--out=file]`.

## Concurrency (`Kongono\Core\Async\Async`, `SafeHttpClient::requestMany`)
- `Async::all(['a' => fn() => ..., 'b' => fn() => ...])`, `Async::race(...)`, `Async::map($items, $fn)`, `Async::allSettled(...)`, `Async::suspend()`
- `$safeHttp->requestMany(['stripe' => ['url' => 'https://...'], 'crm' => ['url' => 'https://...']])` runs parallel SSRF-pinned HTTPS via `curl_multi`.

## Kongono\Live Zero-Build Hypermedia & SSE (`Kongono\Http\Live\*`)
- Mount `new LiveMiddleware()` to serve strict-CSP `/_kongono/live.js` (~3 KB). Add `@liveScript` in layouts.
- HTML attributes: `kgn-get`, `kgn-post`, `kgn-put`, `kgn-patch`, `kgn-delete`, `kgn-target="#el"`, `kgn-swap="innerHTML|outerHTML|beforeend|afterbegin|delete"`, `kgn-confirm="..."`, `kgn-stream="/events"` + `kgn-event="updated"`.
- In controllers: `if ($request->isLive()) return Response::fragment($html, pushUrl: '/new-url');`.

## Database & Fail-Closed Multi-Tenancy (`Kongono\Database\*`)
- `$db->table('invoices')->forTenant(new TenantContext($workspaceId))->where('status', '=', 'open')->orderBy('id', 'DESC')->get();`
- `$db->table('invoices')->requireTenant('workspace_id')` throws `DatabaseException` if `workspace_id` equality filter is omitted.
- Unscoped `UPDATE`/`DELETE` fails closed unless `$allowUnscoped = true`.

## Security & AI Threat Defenses (`Kongono\Security\*`, `Kongono\Ai\Security\*`)
- `AiThreatShieldMiddleware($cache, honeypotPaths: ..., honeypotField: '_hp_website', banSeconds: 900, maxProbesPerWindow: 15, maxCostUnitsPerWindow: 0)`
- `PromptGuard` + `UntrustedInput`: `$p = $guard->buildProtectedSystemPrompt($sys)`, `$guard->wrapUntrusted($input)`, `$guard->detectInjectionSignals($text)`, `$guard->inspectOutput($out, $p['canary'])`
- `SafeHttpClient(allowedHosts: ['api.stripe.com'], allowPlainHttp: false, allowPrivateIps: false)` -> `admitTarget($url)` / `request(...)` / `requestMany(...)`
- `Encryptor($key, previousKeys: [$oldKey])` -> `encrypt($plain, $aad)` / `decrypt($cipher, $aad)`
- `Totp`, `SignedUrl`, `TokenSigner`, `PasswordHasher` (Argon2id), `Principal` + `Gate`, `SecretScrubber::scrub()` / `scrubArray()`

## Views (`.kgn.html`)
- `{{ $escaped }}`, `{!! $slot !!}`, `@liveScript`, `@vite(...)`, `@t('key')`, `@json($val)`, `@extends('layouts/app')`, `@section('content')...@endsection`, `@yield('content')`
- `@if`/`@elseif`/`@else`/`@endif`, `@foreach`/`@endforeach`, `@forelse`/`@empty`/`@endforelse`
- Components: `<x-card title="Static" :tag="$dynamic">Slot</x-card>` -> `views/components/card.kgn.html`

## AI, Governance & MCP (`Kongono\Ai\*`, `Kongono\Cli\*`)
- `AiClient::fromEnv()` (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama) -> `ask()`, `chat()`, `chatStream()`, `structured($prompt, Dto::class)`
- `AgentPrincipal(id, role, allowedTools, maxSteps, maxToolCalls, approvalRequiredTools, maxTokens, maxCostUsd)` + `AgentRunner`
- Built-in CLI: `kongo serve`, `kongo doctor`, `kongo audit [--attack]`, `kongo sdk:generate`, `kongo deploy:init`, `kongo routes`, `kongo graph`, `kongo openapi`, `kongo mcp`, `kongo optimize`, `kongo work`, `kongo oshie`, `kongo chie`, `kongo hantei`
